before.finding: A successful response changed Code back to PDF preview. Removing a focused Cancel control after cancellation or success lost focus.

after.success: A completed compile publishes the source-bound PDF and leaves the current pane selected.
after.focus: Focus returns to Recompile only if Cancel had focus when compilation ended and no other element gained focus. Session expiry still focuses the sign-in notice.
after.recovery: A cancelled request aborts and cannot publish a late PDF. Current source and generation checks remain verified.

browser.transport: Two successful requests were held before routing to the real compiler. Auth, rate admission, the AI suggestion and separate 401 and empty-PDF responses used fixtures.

checks.firstTypecheck: The two new DOM test selectors used a Playwright option outside their Testing Library type. Exact regular expressions preserved their scope.
